title: Wrist strain at a country show
setting: Busy country show. 34M contractor strained his wrist while lifting a heavy load of fencing. Sitting down, holding his wrist in pain.
verdictExplanation: Alert, airway clear, breathing and circulation normal. Isolated soft-tissue wrist strain with no systemic red flags. Injured but not sick: treat on scene.

history.history: Felt a sharp pull in the wrist while lifting 10 minutes ago
history.injuries: Light bruising and swelling on the wrist, painful to move

followUp.question: How should this wrist strain be initially managed?

options.text: Rest the wrist, apply a cold compress, support with a bandage, and elevate
Pull the fingers firmly to try and snap the joint back into place
Call 999 for a priority emergency response
Massage the wrist vigorously to increase blood circulation

followUp.explanation: Initial management of strains is RICE. Reassure the patient and support the wrist. Rigorous manipulation or massage is dangerous and may worsen tissue damage. 999 is inappropriate for minor isolated injuries.

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Support wrist in a comfortable position and apply cold compress. Advise resting the hand.
levelFlags.erNotes: Differentiate from fracture (no bony tenderness or deformity). Support and advise onward care if function does not recover.
